title: 列車自動洗車機~Automatic train-washing plants
focus: 自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接~Water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing
summary: 本課聚焦自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接。從噴洗水量與清水補充建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把乾燥設備穩態熱路與車體偵測到設備退讓連成可驗證的介面，最後以洗車服務與維修配置整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing. Start with spray volume and freshwater makeup to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady thermal paths in drying equipment with from vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through washing service and maintenance allocation. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2015 年品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用回收水配藥質量帳及車型與中止情境矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2015: The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through dosing mass balance for recycled water and vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究噴洗水量與清水補充。原創假想教學輸入：噴洗總流量 flow=0.003 m3/s；噴洗時間 duration=180 s；回收再用比例 recycle=0.75 1。公式 y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000，代入得 y=135 L。邊界：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。敏感度只改 recycle=0.75 至 0.825 1，輸出變為 94.5 L；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究回收水配藥質量帳：原創假想教學輸入：處理水量 volume=800 L；目標教學濃度 concentration=0.002 kg/L。公式 y=volume*concentration，代入得 y=1.6 kg。邊界：純質量平衡教學，不指定實際清潔化學品或使用濃度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate spray volume and freshwater makeup. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total spray flow flow=0.003 m3/s; spray duration duration=180 s; reused fraction recycle=0.75 1. Formula y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000 gives y=135 L. Boundary: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted. For sensitivity, change only recycle=0.75 to 0.825 1; the output becomes 94.5 L. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate dosing mass balance for recycled water: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: treated water volume volume=800 L; assumed teaching concentration concentration=0.002 kg/L. Formula y=volume*concentration gives y=1.6 kg. Boundary: Mass-balance teaching only; no real cleaning chemical or operating concentration is prescribed. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 噴洗水量與清水補充~Spray volume and freshwater makeup
units.title: 噴洗水量與清水補充~Spray volume and freshwater makeup
units.mechanism: 先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。補充清水量取決於總噴洗量與可再用比例，回收水的品質限制和總量限制必須同時滿足。污泥、油脂與清潔劑會改變處理需求；回收率提高不一定等於清洗品質提高，也不能將所有排放都假設成可再用水。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。~Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses. Freshwater makeup depends on spray volume and reusable fraction, subject to both quality and quantity constraints. Sludge, oils and detergents alter treatment needs. Higher recovery is not necessarily better cleaning, and not every discharge can be assumed reusable. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：噴洗總流量 flow=0.003 m3/s；噴洗時間 duration=180 s；回收再用比例 recycle=0.75 1。公式 y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000，代入得 y=135 L。邊界：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total spray flow flow=0.003 m3/s; spray duration duration=180 s; reused fraction recycle=0.75 1. Formula y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000 gives y=135 L. Boundary: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted.
units.verify: 以進水、回流水與排放水三支表做水量平衡，另驗濁度與清潔劑殘留。以「噴洗水量與清水補充」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Balance makeup, return and discharge meters, then test turbidity and detergent residue independently. For spray volume and freshwater makeup, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 回收管漏水會使計算比例看似良好但耗水上升，污染累積則可能使高回收率降低清洗效果。回到「噴洗水量與清水補充」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A leaking return line can increase consumption despite apparent recovery; contaminant accumulation can worsen cleaning at high reuse. Trace the input chain for spray volume and freshwater makeup. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 回收比例越高就能保證清洗效果一定越好~A higher recycling fraction always guarantees better cleaning performance.
units.practice: 只把回收再用比例 recycle 從 0.75 改成 0.825 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 135 變為 94.5 L。先說明「噴洗水量與清水補充」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only reused fraction recycle from 0.75 to 0.825 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 135 to 94.5 L. Explain the causal direction for spray volume and freshwater makeup, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 回收水配藥質量帳~Dosing mass balance for recycled water
units.title: 回收水配藥質量帳~Dosing mass balance for recycled water
units.mechanism: 將槽內已有溶質和本次追加質量分開，先確認濃度用質量每體積表示。再以混合取樣檢查均勻性，避免平均濃度合適卻有局部殘留。配藥量必須以有效處理水量和濃度定義為基礎，質量濃度與體積百分比不能互換。回收水已有殘留物時，追加量不等於全量新配；混合不均與接觸時間不足也會讓平均濃度正常卻有局部清洗差異。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純質量平衡教學，不指定實際清潔化學品或使用濃度。~Separate solute already in the tank from newly added mass and establish the concentration convention first. Sample mixing uniformity so a suitable mean cannot hide local residue. Dosing depends on treated volume and concentration definition; mass concentration and volume percent are not interchangeable. Recycled water already containing residue needs an incremental rather than full fresh dose. Poor mixing or insufficient contact time can cause local differences despite a correct mean concentration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mass-balance teaching only; no real cleaning chemical or operating concentration is prescribed.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：處理水量 volume=800 L；目標教學濃度 concentration=0.002 kg/L。公式 y=volume*concentration，代入得 y=1.6 kg。邊界：純質量平衡教學，不指定實際清潔化學品或使用濃度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: treated water volume volume=800 L; assumed teaching concentration concentration=0.002 kg/L. Formula y=volume*concentration gives y=1.6 kg. Boundary: Mass-balance teaching only; no real cleaning chemical or operating concentration is prescribed.
units.verify: 核對濃度單位與有效成分比例，在不同槽位取樣檢查混合均勻度。以「回收水配藥質量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check concentration units and active fraction, then sample several tank locations to examine mixing uniformity. For dosing mass balance for recycled water, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把商品原液質量當成有效成分質量會配錯比例，感測器污染又可能造成濃度回授偏差。回到「回收水配藥質量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating product mass as active-component mass misdoses the solution; a fouled sensor can bias concentration feedback. Trace the input chain for dosing mass balance for recycled water. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 相同數字的質量百分比與體積百分比一定完全相同~The same numerical mass percentage and volume percentage are always equivalent.
units.practice: 只把處理水量 volume 從 800 改成 880 L（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.6 變為 1.76 kg。先說明「回收水配藥質量帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only treated water volume volume from 800 to 880 L (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.6 to 1.76 kg. Explain the causal direction for dosing mass balance for recycled water, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 吹乾風道工作點~Drying-air duct operating point
units.title: 吹乾風道工作點~Drying-air duct operating point
units.mechanism: 吹乾效果取決於噴口分布與可達風量，不能只比較馬達額定功率。改變濾網阻力時同步記錄壓升和流量，找出能耗上升而乾燥未改善的原因。風機輸入功率由流量乘壓升再除效率估算。壓力不足與流路阻力增加都會改變工作點，不能把銘牌額定流量視為任何風道中都能達成；備援風機還可能共享同一阻塞路徑而無法提供預想的獨立能力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。~Drying depends on outlet distribution and achieved flow rather than motor rating alone. Record pressure and flow while filter resistance changes to explain higher energy use without better drying. Fan input power is flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency. Inadequate pressure and increased duct resistance shift the operating point; nameplate flow is not guaranteed in every duct. Redundant fans may also share a blocked path and fail to provide the expected independent capability. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change.
units.verify: 同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。以「吹乾風道工作點」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure flow, pressure rise and electrical power together, correlate with damper position, and check energy consistency. For drying-air duct operating point, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 風門位置回授正常但機械連桿脫落會形成錯誤狀態，僅看馬達運轉訊號無法證明有足夠送風。回到「吹乾風道工作點」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A detached damper linkage can coexist with apparently normal position feedback; a motor-running signal does not prove adequate airflow. Trace the input chain for drying-air duct operating point. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成~A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
units.practice: 只把總壓升 dp 從 600 改成 660 Pa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 34.2857 變為 37.7143 kW。先說明「吹乾風道工作點」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only total pressure rise dp from 600 to 660 Pa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 34.2857 to 37.7143 kW. Explain the causal direction for drying-air duct operating point, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 乾燥設備穩態熱路~Steady thermal paths in drying equipment
units.title: 乾燥設備穩態熱路~Steady thermal paths in drying equipment
units.mechanism: 以平均發熱功率建立乾燥風機或驅動器的穩態溫度帳，不把此式當成升溫時間模型。比較清潔與堵塞散熱條件，觀察外殼和內部測點是否同向變化。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Build a steady temperature balance using mean dissipation, without treating it as a warm-up-time model. Compare clean and obstructed cooling paths and examine whether enclosure and internal temperatures change together. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.verify: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。以「乾燥設備穩態熱路」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes. For steady thermal paths in drying equipment, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「乾燥設備穩態熱路」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. Trace the input chain for steady thermal paths in drying equipment. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱~A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
units.practice: 只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「乾燥設備穩態熱路」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only equivalent thermal resistance Rth from 0.035 to 0.0385 K/W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 61.5 to 64.65 degC. Explain the causal direction for steady thermal paths in drying equipment, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 洗刷臂液壓推進~Hydraulic positioning of washing arms
units.title: 洗刷臂液壓推進~Hydraulic positioning of washing arms
units.mechanism: 在假想洗刷臂上區分油缸推力與刷具接觸力，連桿和摩擦會改變兩者關係。用隔離教具比對壓力與行程，不能以壓力正常代替車體間隙確認。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。~Separate cylinder thrust from brush contact force in a hypothetical washing arm because linkage and friction change their relationship. Compare pressure and travel on an isolated rig rather than substituting pressure for vehicle-clearance verification. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.

units.anchor: 雙側洗刷臂同步~Synchronizing paired washing arms
units.title: 雙側洗刷臂同步~Synchronizing paired washing arms
units.mechanism: 兩側進給速度的微小差異會隨動作時間累積成位置差。以共同時基比較兩側行程，分辨感測偏移和真實偏斜，並保留異型車體的邊界情境。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~A small difference in paired feed speeds accumulates into position mismatch. Compare travel on a common clock, distinguishing sensor offset from real skew and retaining cases involving different vehicle profiles. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. units.anchor: 車體偵測到設備退讓~From vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal
units.title: 車體偵測到設備退讓~From vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal
units.mechanism: 將車端辨識、控制處理與刷臂退讓各自的起訖時間寫清楚，避免漏算介面等待。以離線事件重播檢查先後次序，不把範例延遲當成現場保護設定。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Define start and finish events for vehicle-end detection, processing and arm withdrawal so handoff waiting is counted. Check ordering through offline replay without using the example delays as field protection settings. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.

units.anchor: 控制紀錄備援續航~Backup duration for control and logging
units.title: 控制紀錄備援續航~Backup duration for control and logging
units.mechanism: 備援供電範圍限定為狀態監視與紀錄，不假設電池能維持全部洗車動力。將平均能量需求與啟動瞬間壓降分開，確認失電事件仍可被追溯。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。~Limit the backup boundary to monitoring and logging rather than assuming that it powers the entire washing plant. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. units.anchor: 車型與中止情境矩陣~Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix
units.title: 車型與中止情境矩陣~Vehicle-profile and interruption test matrix
units.mechanism: 把不同車頭外形、感測失效與洗程中止列成分開案例，不以多次同車試洗取代型式覆蓋。核對每案的設備狀態與復原證據，留下未驗證的條件。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~List distinct cases for vehicle profiles, sensing failures and interrupted cycles rather than repeating one vehicle as a substitute for coverage. Check state and recovery evidence and retain untested conditions explicitly. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

units.anchor: 洗車服務與維修配置~Washing service and maintenance allocation
units.title: 洗車服務與維修配置~Washing service and maintenance allocation
units.mechanism: 區分可洗車、降級服務和完全停機，維修履歷才不會高估可用時間。再比較頻繁短停與罕見長停如何影響回廠列車排隊，保留相同可用度下的差異。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Distinguish full service, degraded washing and complete shutdown to avoid overstated availability. Compare how frequent brief stops and rare long outages affect returning-train queues despite equal long-run availability. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
